mapper.select: SELECT ui.user_id, ui.user_integral FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class btg ON btg.member_id = ui.user_id WHERE btg.member_class_id in (SELECT id FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_membership_grade WHERE grade_start = 0) or btg.member_class_id is null
SELECT id FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_membership_grade where grade_rule < #{userIntegral} and grade_start = 1 ORDER BY grade_rule desc limit 1
select sum(total_integral) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base where integral_goods = 0 and order_status in (5,6) and buyer_user_id = #{userId}
